title: OrderBookBucket
description: The order book data for a partition of the instrument's prices.

price.description: The lowest price (inclusive) covered by the bucket. The bucket covers the price range from the price to price + the order book's bucketWidth.
price.format: A decimal number encodes as a string. The amount of precision provided depends on the Instrument.

longCountPercent.description: The percentage of the total number of orders represented by the long orders found in this bucket.
longCountPercent.format: A decimal number encoded as a string. The amount of precision provided depends on what the number represents.

shortCountPercent.description: The percentage of the total number of orders represented by the short orders found in this bucket.
shortCountPercent.format: A decimal number encoded as a string. The amount of precision provided depends on what the number represents.
